items.title: Rahmfleck at Marienplatz
items.desc: Bavarian wood-fired flatbread topped with sour cream, bacon & chives.

items.title: 5:15 PM Rathaus Balcony Music
items.desc: Arrive in Marienplatz by 5 PM on Sun Dec 20 or Tue Dec 22; check the programme.

items.title: Residenz Village Before Dec 22 Close
items.desc: Visit Tuesday early afternoon; final Dec 22 close is 8 PM.

items.title: Drachenblut at Medieval Market
items.desc: Hot spiced cherry-and-honey mead in a clay goblet at Wittelsbacherplatz.

items.title: Drei im Weggla
items.desc: Three marjoram-seasoned Nürnberger sausages in a crusty roll with mustard.

items.title: Original Elisenlebkuchen
items.desc: Nut-rich gingerbread; check flour, wafer and allergen ingredients before ordering.

items.title: Heidelbeer-Glühwein
items.desc: Nuremberg's signature blueberry mulled wine at Hauptmarkt.

items.title: Spin the Schöner Brunnen Brass Ring
items.desc: Spin the seamless brass ring 3 times for luck + watch 12:00 PM Männleinlaufen clock.

items.title: Zwetschgenmännla Souvenir
items.desc: Traditional handmade chimney-sweep or figure crafted from dried prunes & walnuts.

items.title: Charles Bridge at Dusk
items.desc: Dec 23 lamplighter is an optional bonus: reconfirm timing and skip if arrival is delayed.

items.title: Svařák & Hot Medovina
items.desc: Czech citrus-spiced mulled wine and hot honey mead on Old Town Square.

items.title: Bramboráky & Charcoal-Spit Trdelník
items.desc: Crispy garlic-marjoram potato pancakes & piping-hot cinnamon walnut chimney cake.

items.title: Old Town Square Christmas Tree
items.desc: Enjoy the decorations; add a light show only if the 2026 programme confirms it.

items.title: Dec 26 Vienna Market Evening
items.desc: Maria-Theresien-Platz before conservative 4 PM cutoff, then cathedral and Rathaus if time allows.

items.title: Käsekrainer & Maroni
items.desc: Cheese-stuffed smoked sausage & hot roasted chestnuts in a two-pocket paper cone.

items.title: Kaiserschmarren at Belvedere / Schönbrunn
items.desc: Fluffy shredded caramelized emperor's pancake with warm plum compote on Sun Dec 27.

items.title: ChristkindlTram (Dec 20 Final Day) & Stachus Eiszauber
items.desc: Spot Munich's festive tram at Sendlinger Tor (ends Sun Dec 20) & pass the Stachus open-air ice rink.

items.title: Vánočka Bread & Czech Cauldron Soup
items.desc: Try braided raisin-almond Vánočka & hot garlic (česnečka) or sauerkraut (zelňačka) soup.

items.title: Red Boot Mug & Rathaus Heart-Handle Mug
items.desc: Spot the iconic red boot mugs (Stephansplatz/Belvedere) & heart-handle mugs (Rathausplatz).

items.title: Selchfleischknödel, Bosna, Schaumrollen & Vanillekipferl
items.desc: Smoked-meat potato dumplings, spicy Bosna sausage roll, meringue pastry horns & vanilla crescents.
